statement: The Solver distinguishes undeclared Quest drafts from active open work in portfolio projections; a flat attempt that reuses the exact same non-empty evidence fingerprint is recorded as a receipt-only source revision that holds its rung and does not advance supervisor durable progress, while fresh flat evidence still climbs; and evidence ingestion records one structured evidence event without a mirrored synthetic finding, preserving terminal projection, blocker movement, and explicit findings.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not rewrite historical logs or introduce a new store-level Quest status; new classifications must project safely over legacy events.

Only flat attempts with equal non-empty before/after evidence fingerprints may hold as receipt-only; fresh flat evidence, missing identities, and honesty or convergence violations must preserve existing climb or gate behavior.
Removing the generated ingestion summary must not remove explicit findings, structured evidence fields, theory results, blocker movement, or terminal reopening behavior.
